## Columns

- **since**: first release tag whose `field_table.rs` has the row; `<=0.1.22` means the row was in the table when it was created (the key may be older; see `CHANGELOG.md`).
- **readers**: pattern hits, test code excluded. `chk` rlm `check/src` (the rules `play_launch check` runs); `drv` rlm `derive/src`, `sched/src`; `pl` play_launch `src/ros-launch-resolve/resolve/src` minus the model builder (a copy, not a read) and the explain files; `exp` play_launch `verbs/check.rs` and `ros/budget_book.rs` (the `--explain` tables); `rt` play_launch `src/play_launch/src` (launch, runtime enforcement); `ncg` nano-ros `packages/cli` (code generation, sizing); `nrt` the rest of nano-ros `packages` (runtime). nano-ros reads rlm at the tag its `Cargo.toml` pins, so a key added after that tag cannot have a nano-ros reader yet.
- A row marked *shared* has a field name another context also uses; its reader count is an upper bound. The analysis below resolves the ones that matter by reading the code.
- **writers**: occurrences in contracts, per repository (`pl` play_launch, `rlm`, `island`, `nros`); **forms** are the value shapes written (scalar / map / list).

## One fact, two places

| row A | written | row B | written | relation |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `pub/sub/cli.<endpoint>.max_transport` | pl 4 | `topics.<name>.max_transport` | pl 2 | G3 done: the subscriber's is kept; the topic's is deprecated and `migrate` copies it onto each subscriber stating none |
| `paths.<name>.drop` | pl 3, rlm 3 | `topics.<name>.drop` | pl 2, rlm 6 | G3 done: the topic's is the hop loss; a scope path's is the E2E budget (`drop-tightness`); a node path's is refused |
| `manifest.external_topics` | pl 1 | `topics.<name>.external` | pl 210, rlm 1, island 32, nros 17 | both land in the model's one `externals` set (G3) |
| `None.external` | **none** | `None.side` | **none** | deprecated alias and its canonical key; only the alias is written |
| `paths.<name>.input` | pl 3 | `trigger.input` | pl 511, rlm 54, island 40, nros 1 | legacy and current spelling of an input trigger; `effective_trigger()` merges them (new) |
| `None.all_of` | **none** | `functions.<name>.all_of` | pl 4, island 1 | an inline redundant group, and the same group named (new) |
| `safe_state.settle` | pl 125, island 10 | `safe_state.settle.duration` | pl 11, island 6 | G6 done: `settle: <d>` is shorthand for `{ duration: <d> }`, one fact in one map form |
| `hazards.<name>.severity` | pl 1 | `nodes.<name>.criticality` | pl 12 | criticality is derived from severity; a written label is a second copy (G5) |
| `trigger.timer.rate_hz` | pl 176, rlm 1, island 18, nros 26 | `topics.<name>.rate_hz` | pl 27, rlm 44, island 13, nros 4 | a topic's rate is derived from the timers (`derivable-rate`) (new, deferred) |
| `topics.<name>.qos` | pl 3, rlm 46 | `pub/sub/cli.<endpoint>.qos` | pl 86, rlm 3, island 61, nros 38 | topic default, endpoint override: kept, both sides share the profile |

## One key, several meanings

| key | context: meaning (written) | phase 90 |
|---|---|---|
| `reaction` | `hazards.<name>`: a mode (ladder) or a scope path (one rung) (pl 46, island 3); `modes.<name>`: a scope path (pl 119, island 7); `on_violation`: a path on the subscriber's own node (pl 136, island 9) | G4 |
| `on` | `hazards.<name>`: fault classes (pl 121, island 10); `on_violation`: fault classes (pl 136, island 9); `modes.<name>.exit`: a function name (pl 1) | new |
| `param` | `trigger.timer`: bare parameter on the path's node, Hz or s (pl 1); `<budget> (map form)`: bare on `max_age`'s node, or `<node>.<parameter>` on a window, s (pl 3, island 3) | G2 done: one `ParamBinding` |
| `duration` | `<budget> (map form)`: the bound (a mode's window too) (pl 39, island 78); `safe_state.settle`: the written settle (pl 11, island 6) | G6 done |
| `rate_hz` | `topics.<name>`: a consequence (pl 27, rlm 44, island 13, nros 4); `trigger.timer`: a fact (pl 176, rlm 1, island 18, nros 26) | deferred |
| `type` | `topics.<name>`: message type (pl 452, rlm 109, island 55, nros 49); `params.<name>`: ROS 2 parameter type (pl 132, island 29, nros 37); `args.<name>`: `bool` or free string (rlm 5) | benign |
| `external` | `topics.<name>`: pub \| sub \| both (pl 210, rlm 1, island 32, nros 17); `services.<name>`: server \| client \| both (pl 2, nros 2); `None`: alias of `side` (**none**) | benign |
